superseded_releases.reason: Contains two test pieces explicitly rejected by the user.
Three separate primary sheets, oversized 76mm DOT and no-longer-requested brand keyrings.

Len ORIGIN V1 (8 pieces, 2.5 mm clear rims, doors/moon/clouds as separate framed plates) rejected by the owner as too many borders; masters stay at commit 2ac3ad0, replaced by V2 (5 pieces, 1.0 mm rim, merged back panel).

Len ORIGIN V2 masters (commit 73a2823, local, never pushed as a release): one back panel, 1.0 mm rim and see-through preview. Its composition is the owner's preferred design and the base of V4, V6, V7 and V8 (the V2 masters themselves were never gated as a release; V6 re-registers the same composition with the tree printed diagonally the right way and Len shown whole).

Len ORIGIN V3 masters (commit 657a484, release registration c5faa9e; pushed to after_days/sleeg only, never to main/output_len): Len 125 mm centred with the serpent directly behind her. The owner prefers V2 ("v2가 낫다고 한거야"), so V3 was superseded by V4 before publication. Masters and preview stay retrievable at the masters commit.

Len ORIGIN V4 masters (commit a2a83cd, release registration 84be30c; pushed to after_days/sleeg only, never to main/output_len): the V2 design with the blossom tree printed into the back panel (but rotated the wrong way by a builder sign error) and Len cropped at the seat line. The owner wants exactly two changes on V4 - the cropping fixed and the tree diagonal like the concept - which V6 applied; V4 was superseded by V5, V6, V7 and then V8 before publication. Masters and preview stay retrievable at the masters commit.

Len ORIGIN V5 masters (commit 7459c7f, release registration c91c4a4; pushed to after_days/sleeg only, never to main/output_len): Len whole seated on a 70 mm serpent's coil and the blossom tree back as a separate diagonal cut plate. The owner rejected the restructure ("이거 아니야 v4에서 잘림 문제만 해결하고 나무를 예시 이미지처럼 대각선 배치 해달라고"), so V5 was superseded by V6 (V4 + only the two requested changes) before publication. Masters and preview stay retrievable at the masters commit.

Len ORIGIN V6 masters (commit 62963a8, release registration b40cd6b; pushed to after_days/sleeg only, never to main/output_len): the V4 design with Len shown whole and the blossom tree printed into the back panel leaning up to the right (35 deg clockwise, 100 mm). The owner then decided the tree must be separate assets ("벚꽃하고 나무는 별도 에셋으로 분리해줘"), so V6 was superseded by V7 (the tree as its own wood cut piece plus six pink blossom cluster plates on clear stems) and then by V8 before publication. Masters and preview stay retrievable at the masters commit.

Len ORIGIN V7 masters (commit e8a480e, release registration 3a0d70f; pushed to after_days/sleeg only, never to main/output_len): the blossom tree split into a wood cut piece plus six pink blossom cluster plates on clear stems, the lattice doors still printed flat on the back panel. The owner corrected the design ("벚꽃-나무는 하나여야지" - the blossom tree must be ONE piece; "저 문" - the assets he wanted separate are the doors), so V7 was superseded by V8 (one-piece tree with real cut-out openings, two lattice door plates, sky extended into the former door zones) before publication. Masters and preview stay retrievable at the masters commit.
